name: OrderFusion Lite – Order Filters, Columns & Export for WooCommerce
author: SpellDot

sections.description:
Order Filters, Columns & Export for WooCommerce extends the default WooCommerce Orders admin screen with professional-level tools. Advanced combinable filters, customizable columns, and quick CSV exports help store managers handle orders efficiently.

The plugin works with both WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and legacy systems.

Features

Filters – Filter orders by Products, Status, Shipping Method, Payment Method, Order Total, Date Range, and Customer Name. Combine multiple filters and apply them instantly via AJAX.

Custom Columns – Display additional order information: Products list, Customer Note, Phone, and Email.

Screen Options Integration – Activate, deactivate, or rearrange columns and filters using WordPress’ built-in interface.

CSV Export – Export selected or filtered orders; batch processing prevents timeouts on large datasets.

HPOS Compatibility – Fully tested with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage using optimized database queries.

User-Specific Settings – Preferences are saved individually per WordPress user for personalized workflows.

Privacy-Focused – The plugin works entirely on the WordPress backend; customer data never leaves your server.

Pro Version

Need more power? The Pro version includes:

  • Unlimited filters (20+ filter types)
  • Unlimited custom columns
  • Custom filters & columns from any order meta field
  • Saved views for quick filter/column presets
  • Table-style CSV export format
  • Infinite scroll for large datasets

Get OrderFusion Pro

License

This plugin is released under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Full license terms are available at https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

Third Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following open source libraries:

  • Flatpickr – Lightweight date picker for date filters (MIT License)
    Source: https://github.com/flatpickr/flatpickr

  • Tooltipster – Tooltip library for UI hints (MIT License)
    Source: https://github.com/iamceege/tooltipster
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin package to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it through Plugins >> Add New >> Upload Plugin.

  2. Activate “Order Filters, Columns & Export for WooCommerce” via Plugins >> Installed Plugins.

  3. Go to WooCommerce >> Orders and click Screen Options (top right) to manage columns and filters.

  4. To export orders to CSV, use bulk actions “Export selected to CSV” or “Export All to CSV”.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. All reading and writing operations fully support HPOS order tables, ensuring great performance on modern WooCommerce stores.

Does the plugin work with WordPress multisite?

Yes. Settings are saved separately per site.

Does this plugin affect front-end loading speed?

No. The plugin only works in the WordPress admin area and does not load assets on the front-end.

Can exported CSV files be opened in Excel or Google Sheets?

Yes. The CSV files use standard formatting and open easily in Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers, and LibreOffice.

What’s the difference between the free and Pro versions?

The free version includes 7 filters and 4 columns. The Pro version offers 20+ filters, unlimited columns, saved views for quick filter/column presets, custom meta field filters/columns, and additional features like infinite scroll and table-style CSV export.
